packages.A: POST per 277 - UnitedHealthcare family (UNI20/UHCMA/AARP): post the payer's paid amount + check number + paid date as the payment, write off the remainder (WOINS, WOCAID2ND when the other plan is Medicaid)
packages.B: POST per 277 - Florida Blue: same shape
packages.C: POST per 277 - other carriers answered PAID on the exact date of service (Aetna, Simply, Humana, Cigna, Medicaid ...)
packages.D: WRITE OFF untimely - Medicare, never adjudicated (or a $0 denial posted), DOS over 12 months (WOINS no answer / WOLATE answered; never sent to Medicare past a year)
packages.E: WRITE OFF untimely - UHC family / Florida Blue, never adjudicated, DOS over 12 months (WOLATE when the payer answered, WOINS when it did not)
packages.F: WRITE OFF untimely - every other carrier, never adjudicated, DOS over 12 months (WOLATE / WOINS as above)
packages.G: RESEND once as an original claim (freq 1) - payer says NOT ON FILE, inside 12 months (standing Sunday-sweep rule)
packages.H: Medicare, inside 12 months, no adjudication on the chart - resend once as an original claim (freq 1; deceased guard + one-rebill rule apply)
packages.I: SMALL BALANCE - adjudicated cost-sharing, no other plan on the chart, the patient's whole open cost-sharing is under $25 -> WOSMBAL (9/11 rule) - not offered tonight (needs the whole account read)
packages.J: DUAL, Medicaid plan already answered - Medicare/MA paid, a Medicaid-family plan (Medicaid / FCC / Simply / Sunshine / Georgia Medicaid / Humana Medicaid) has posted its $0 answer on the visit -> the cost-sharing residual is WOCAID2ND, never billed to the patient (9/11 rule)
packages.K: DUAL, Medicaid plan not yet answered - same facts but the Medicaid-family plan has no posting on the visit yet: WOCAID2ND now skips the crossover (it would almost always answer $0 - primary paid at or above the Medicaid allowed)
